author: FChecklist
body:
AUDIT: FAIL
Objective Understood: Reviewed worker task 'Add query-once + decide-and-fix rules to server-native PM' (risk tier: tier1) by reading the actual diff, not a self-report.
Standards Reviewed: AGENTS.md Operating Rule 7c structured audit protocol; risk-tier.py's deterministic tier classification.
Scope Confirmed:  STATUS_REPORT.md | 312 ++++++++++++++++++++++++-------------------------------
 1 file changed, 138 insertions(+), 174 deletions(-)
Evidence Recorded: This diff is a byte-for-byte duplicate of already-merged work: verified via git that the diff's source blob (899d5eb) is STATUS_REPORT.md as of commit ba749c6/21348ef, and its target blob (066bdb7) is exactly the STATUS_REPORT.md already committed at e11e5e5 (git rev-parse e11e5e5:STATUS_REPORT.md == 066bdb7), which is the current tip of master, committed 2026-08-13T14:11:22Z -- moments before this task's own result.json was written at 14:12. In other words, whatever produced this diff either raced with, or is a stale re-submission of, the exact change that already landed on master under UMR-20260813-105106-e9a7. Approving and autonomously merging this would be a redundant no-op against master (content already present) and is itself the kind of duplicate-dispatch/duplicate-work event the standing dispatch rules (NO DUPLICATION, step 8-9) exist to prevent. Separately, and unverifiable from this diff alone, the report's substantive claims -- a commit pushed to FChecklist/veridian-scripts#299 (5e3eeeb), and PRs #298 and #143 closed -- describe actions in other repos not visible in this diff, so per the standing instruction not to trust a self-report, those specific claims were not and could not be independently confirmed here. Issues found: Diff target content (blob 066bdb7) is already the current STATUS_REPORT.md on master (commit e11e5e5) -- this PR/diff is fully redundant, not new work to merge.; The task's own result appears to have completed (14:12) just after e11e5e5 was committed (14:11:22), suggesting this task raced with or duplicates another invocation of the same UMR chain rather than being distinct incremental work.; Claims about actions in the veridian-scripts repo (commit 5e3eeeb on PR #299, closing PR #298) and closing claude-control#143 are outside this diff's scope and were not independently verifiable from the diff alone.; Recommend closing this task/PR as superseded by e11e5e5 rather than merging, and auditing why the dispatcher allowed a duplicate task against a UMR chain whose content had just been merged.
Severity Classified: medium
Verdict: fail
Corrective Action Owner: Worker to address the findings listed above and resubmit.
Re-Audit Scheduled: Required after corrective changes are pushed.
